integrity: All assertions in the result are supported by an explicit all-size proof and a separately executable finite-field checker. No independent audit is represented.
limitations: The poset has no chain of three distinct comparable elements.
The compact formulas cover forests and connected unicyclic Hasse graphs; other graphs use the exact double sum.
Finite checker runs use prime fields of orders 2 and 3, not all prime powers.
Publication priority and external mathematical validation are not established.
title: Centralizer-rank polynomials of toric and complexity-one incidence monoids
